item.title: Can Lebanon's Hezbollah survive another war with Israel?
item.summary: With its ally Iran now at war with the U.S. and Israel, and the Israel Defence Forces pounding Hezbollah’s weapons storage and infrastructure and killing senior leadership, can the militant group survive another war?

item.title: Israel keeps eliminating Iran's top leaders. How is it impacting the war?
item.summary: Iran continues to launch missiles, raising questions as to whether its mosaic defence doctrine has enabled the country to fight on despite the decapitation of its top leadership.

item.title: Trump to Japan's PM: 'Why didn’t you tell me about Pearl Harbor?'
item.summary: When asked why the U.S. didn't consult allies in Asia and Europe before attacking Iran, U.S. President Donald Trump said his administration wanted the attack to be a 'surprise,' and made a joke referencing Japan's military strike on Pearl Harbor.

item.title: Tehran intensifies attacks on Gulf energy facilities after Israel hits Iranian gas field
item.summary: Iran intensified its attacks on its Gulf Arab neighbours' energy infrastructure Thursday, hitting a Saudi refinery on the Red Sea and setting Qatari liquefied natural gas facilities and two Kuwaiti oil refineries ablaze as it struck back following an Israeli attack on its main...

item.title: Iran will not play World Cup games in U.S., says soccer chief
item.summary: Iran were one of the first nations to qualify for the finals but their participation has been in doubt since the conflict between the Islamic Republic and the United States began in late February.

item.title: Trump has delayed the Beijing summit. China wonders if he'll ever come to the negotiating table
item.summary: The question echoing through Beijing’s diplomatic and political circles is whether U.S. President Donald Trump will show up for a summit in Beijing that was originally supposed to take place this month. Distracted by a self-launched war in Iran and facing mounting domestic pre...

item.title: Iran hits Qatar energy hub after its Pars oil field struck
item.summary: Iran accused Israel of striking its facilities in the huge Pars gas field on Wednesday in a major escalation in the U.S.-Israeli war that sent oil prices ‌shooting higher, and retaliated ‌by vowing attacks on oil and gas targets throughout the Gulf, firing missiles at Qatar an...

item.title: Last detainee from Trump’s 2025 Gaza war protest crackdown freed after a year
item.summary: For Leqaa Kordia, her newfound freedom means little to her until “everybody is free." “There is a lot of injustice in this place,” Kordia told reporters after emerging from a U.S. immigration detention centre in Texas on Monday. “There are a lot of people that shouldn’t be her...

item.title: Pakistan and Afghanistan announce temporary pause in fighting
item.summary: Pakistan and Afghanistan have declared a temporary pause in escalating fighting, two days after Kabul blamed Islamabad for a deadly airstrike in the Afghan capital that it said killed hundreds of people at a drug rehabilitation hospital.

item.title: Israeli airstrikes in Beirut intensify, demolishing a 10-storey building and striking bridges
item.summary: Israel stepped up airstrikes on Beirut on Wednesday, killing at least 10 people and destroying a 10-storey building near the city center in the third week of its war with Hezbollah, Lebanese authorities said.
